coverage_note: Briefs: 173 (incl. NPCs). Set 1 covers 1062,1032,1026,1145,1087,1010,1030,1017,1018,1003 + a generic Mejiro line; the planned Mejiro set covers 1013,1027,1059,1064,1071,1074,1086. The 6 suggested sets add 29 umas, none of them in Set 1 or the Mejiro set, bringing coverage to 46 of 135 playable umas. Name families with only one member in the data (Daitaku Helios, Tanino Gimlet, Yamanin Zephyr, Eishin Flash, Daiichi Ruby, Zenno Rob Roy, Nishino Flower) have no family entry; Gold (Ship/City), Curren (Chan/Bouquetd'or) and Daring (Tact/Heart) share only a word and were not treated as families. Top-25 home-scene list = 17 pairs (home x6-x11, incl. the Orfevre & Dream Journey family entry; McQueen-Ryan x7 left to the Mejiro entry; Verxina-Vivlos, Loves Only You-Chrono Genesis, Believe-Calstone, C.B.-Katsuragi and Gold Ship-Festa folded into their trios) + 8 trios ranked by weakest edge (x4-x5), two of which are the sisters and Fastest-trio entries. Anime/manga-only teams are marked; web-only claims (Tetra Mystics, JAMD, Team Sirius, Ascella, Chanchan Alliance, Heisei Big Three) are labelled as such. Still uncovered and worth a later set: the 2002 cohort (Kris S, Tanino Gimlet, No Reason, Hishi Miracle), the new-gen Tiara cohort (Air Messiah, Daring Heart, Rhein Kraft, Cesario), the sprinters (Helios, Ruby, K.S.Miracle, Yamanin Zephyr), and Rose Kingdom / Victoire Pisa / Eishin Flash.
